deathChamberWog.log.open: The Undead King rises! Four crypts, twelve haunted trees and fourteen grave markers seal the Death Chamber.
deathChamberWog.log.incomplete: The Undead King rises! Some Death Chamber obstacles could not be placed.
deathChamberWog.log.second: The great crypts collapse! Four Lich reinforcements emerge.
deathChamberWog.log.third: The dead return! Four Ghost companies join the fight.
deathChamberWog.warning.enter:
{Death Chamber}

As you approach the ominous skull structure, you are greeted by a grotesque undead Lich King. "Welcome to my Death Chamber!" he proclaims in a sinister voice.  "I know you are here to steal my ancient treasures!  If you enter this chamber, my {massive legion} of loyal servants will destroy you with the deadliest force possible!  Will you HEED my warning or SUFFER a grisly death?"

deathChamberWog.ert.170057:
Upon defeating the Undead King and his guards, you ransack the Death Chamber and discover an ancient treasure chest sitting atop a pile of dead corpses.  The chest magically opens, releasing the spirits of tortured souls into the air.

"Thank you for releasing us from the wrath of the evil King!" the spirits chant in unison.  "To show our eternal gratitude, we will accompany you in your journeys throughout this hostile land!"
deathChamberWog.ert.170058: After releasing the spirits, you dig through the treasure chest further and find the King’s precious riches buried beneath the decayed skulls and bones of fallen heroes!

deathChamberWog.hint:
{Death Chamber}

A haunted vault ruled by the Undead King. Its guards grow stronger as weeks pass. Chambers reset at the beginning of every 28-day cycle.

wake-of-gods.mapobjects.deathchamber.scr:
{Death Chamber}
Summons the Undead King’s retainers, raises the dead in later rounds, and commands unholy magic.

{Undead King’s Curse}
The King curses creatures that act against him.
